theme_stances.key_argument: AI exposure is a dominant driver of index variance, often hidden within diversified portfolios.
theme_stances.evidence: it has explained more Russell 1000 index variance than the 1st principal component

theme_stances.key_argument: The clarity provided by PJM filings incentivizes hyperscalers to sign PPAs to lock in supply and avoid energy price volatility.
theme_stances.evidence: hyperscalers will still be incentivized to sign data center PPAs

theme_stances.key_argument: Info Services stock reactions more commonly reflected fundamental performance rather than AI fears in 2Q.
theme_stances.evidence: Info Services stock reactions more commonly reflected fundamental performance rather than AI fears

theme_stances.key_argument: The AI build-out is driven by contest externalities and circular financing that create endogenous financial fragility.
theme_stances.evidence: The race to commit early through debt and circular financing also makes a bust more likely.

theme_stances.key_argument: Nvidia's new financing deals to turn compute into an investable asset signal the beginning of the end for the AI boom.
theme_stances.evidence: I suspect Nvidia’s mooted deal is the beginning of the end

theme_stances.key_argument: The financialization of GPUs creates systemic correlation risk that mirrors the pre-GFC housing bubble.
theme_stances.evidence: Nvidia’s proposed deal just moved us a little closer to eventually seeing this financial force.

theme_stances.key_argument: The AI boom is a credit-driven real estate cycle that relies on continuous refinancing rather than a sustainable technology cycle.
theme_stances.evidence: the AI financing model only works if demand growth keeps accelerating

theme_stances.key_argument: Current equity valuations are unsustainable given the 5% risk-free rate and lack of proven returns on AI capex.
theme_stances.evidence: I really don't understand why you should be in the extremely highly valued US stock market.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI earnings remain the market's universal solvent with strong outperformance this week.
theme_stances.evidence: AI earnings remain the market's universal solvent with strong outperformance

theme_stances.key_argument: The transition from a technology story to a financing story is creating credit market stress as capex outpaces free cash flow.
theme_stances.evidence: We’re entering crunch time for capital

theme_stances.key_argument: The AI infrastructure buildout is durable and elongated, supporting continued growth in semiconductor demand.
theme_stances.evidence: we view today's AI Infrastructure buildout as durable and elongated

theme_stances.key_argument: AI fundamentals remain intact and hyperscalers benefit from improved capex ROI.
theme_stances.evidence: our view is that Tech is on its way up

theme_stances.key_argument: Investors should own the physical infrastructure required to produce AI tokens rather than the models themselves.
theme_stances.evidence: Own the infrastructure required to produce billions of them.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI infrastructure stocks have accounted for 50% of S&P 500 EPS growth in Q2.
theme_stances.evidence: AI infrastructure stocks have accounted for 50% of that EPS growth

theme_stances.key_argument: Infrastructure and hardware are identified as the primary bottlenecks for current AI development.
theme_stances.evidence: No. 7 on infrastructure and hardware as the bottleneck

theme_stances.key_argument: AI capex is and should continue to be a tailwind for growth.
theme_stances.evidence: AI capex is and should continue to be a tailwind for growth.

theme_stances.evidence: monoline insurer risk in AI capex
